name: openra-acceptance-test
description:
Acceptance test verification team. Validates manual acceptance test pages via Playwright automated testing. Task prompt is set at spawn time.

CRITICAL WORKFLOW RULES (applicable ONLY during bug-fix phases — Path B1/B2a):
1. REDUNDANCY CHECK (post re-verification): After test-runner re-verifies a bug fix, developer OR acceptance-tester MUST audit the previous bug-fix modifications to determine whether any of them are now redundant (e.g., workarounds that the actual root-cause fix made unnecessary). If redundant changes are found, revert them and then dispatch test-runner for a FINAL re-verification.
2. COMMIT GATE (bug-fix only): During bug-fix phases (Path B1/B2a), code MUST NOT be committed until test-runner's final re-verification passes. No commits are allowed while a bug is still unresolved. Only after the final re-verification is APPROVED may the fix be committed.

NOTE: During initial acceptance test page DEVELOPMENT (new page creation), normal commit rules apply — commit after migration-review APPROVED. The commit gate and redundancy check only activate when FIXING bugs found by the test-runner.

members.name: team-lead
members.role: Orchestrate acceptance test verification workflow. Route between runner, assistant, developer, reviewer, and architect.

members.name: test-runner
members.role: Write Playwright test scripts, execute browser automation, collect evidence (screenshots/videos), produce reproduce docs and test reports under test-results/manual/. During bug-fix phase: after a fix is applied, perform re-verification. After redundancy audit is complete, perform final re-verification — only after this final pass is APPROVED may bug-fix code be committed (commit gate). During dev phase: verify new pages without blocking commits.

members.name: acceptance-tester
members.role: Create new acceptance test pages (dev phase) and fix test page issues (Path B1 bug-fix phase). Diagnose whether failures are test-page or source-code related (B1 vs B2). Can modify src/__e2e__/manual/ files. During dev phase: commit after reviewer APPROVED. During bug-fix phase (B1): after test-runner re-verifies, audit prior modifications for redundancy — revert any redundant changes and trigger test-runner final re-verification. BUG-FIX COMMITS: DO NOT commit until test-runner's final re-verification passes. Dev phase commits follow normal rules.

members.name: developer
members.role: Fix source code issues found by acceptance testing (Path B2a bug-fix phase). Add negative unit tests for the failure case. After test-runner re-verifies, audit prior bug-fix modifications for redundancy — revert any redundant changes (e.g., workarounds made obsolete by the root-cause fix) and trigger test-runner final re-verification. BUG-FIX COMMITS: DO NOT commit until test-runner's final re-verification passes.

members.name: reviewer
members.role: 5-dimension code review for fixes from Path B1 and Path B2a.

members.name: architect
members.role: Re-plan module architecture for major issues (Path B2b). Report findings to user.
